title: New Dance October Joy
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 7 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
The progression after row 7 "partners balance & swing · swing" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 2 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 3 "robins chain to partner" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins must start on opposite sides of the set.
Row 6 "partners do si do once" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 2 and 3 are too far apart to do-si-do.
Row 7 "partners balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 2 and 3 are too far apart to balance.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
Give & take: half the beats to cross, half to back home holding both hands.
